notes: Flip gate for the compiler's bounds hoisting (`bounds_hoist::run`), ported
as @vesper/bounds-hoist (SH3 lane 12, #1251) and installed as the hybrid's
`hoist` hook. A compiler module: its Rust (src/bounds_hoist.rs) is deleted
by the Rust compiler's retirement (SH6 lane 2), not by this flip.
The whole corpus at the hoisting boundary (294 programs).
The module's own speed: the pass on input bytes, the place-ir identity
read and write subtracted. One epoch is about a minute over the corpus.
The plan's compiler-module bar: the whole native optimize pipeline of
every corpus `main` with the swap against without it (about 2 s an arm).
Not gated: the `hook` workload (BOUNDS_HOIST_GATE_WORKLOAD=hook) times the
hybrid hook alone, with the whole program encoded to words and decoded
back around the pass. That boundary is the hybrid's, and it goes away
once the IR pipeline around the pass is Vesper too.
name: bounds-hoist
